## Added
- **Energy Cells now pull power from the grid themselves.** A cell on the Energy Pipe network actively banks energy from any source on it — the Hydroelectric Generator and, notably, third-party push-sources like Tech Reborn solar panels or any FE / Reborn-Energy generator. Previously a cell could only be *pushed* into, so a foreign generator wired in through pipes never charged it; now it does. Cells still never pull from one another, so a bank won't slosh energy internally.

## Changed
- **Liquid pipes move fluid 4× faster** — 3 → 12 mB/tick (240 mB/s). A full tank transfers in ~1 minute instead of ~4½, so bulk fluid routing is actually usable. Still gentle next to industrial fluid pipes, and the batching/performance behaviour is unchanged.
- **Hydroponics crops grow noticeably faster** — the crop cycle drops from ~7.3 to ~4.7 minutes per harvest (~57% faster yield), so a crop bed no longer feels sluggish beside a tree bed.
- **Beds now draw meaningfully more water** — ~300 mB per crop, so water actually matters at scale: one Liquid Siphon comfortably supplies ~23 full beds before you need a second. A starter farm won't notice, and running short only *pauses* growth — no water or progress is ever lost.

## Fixed
- **Multi-tank Liquid Tank clusters fill and empty fully by hand.** Emptying a bucket into — or filling one from — a stacked or merged tank now uses the whole connected pool instead of only the tank you clicked, so a 1×2 tank no longer caps at a single tank's worth.
